JUDGMENT

This is a charge sheet presented by the Police Inspector of Madivala police station, Bengaluru against the accused No.1 and 2 for the offences punishable under Sec.302 R/w Sec.34 of IPC .
2.

The brief facts of the prosecution case is that: On 09.10.2017 at about 3.30 a.m accused No.1 and 2 were going near Madivala, Tavarekere main road on two wheeler bearing No.KA01ET8840,
the deceased Pranay Mishra punched by his honda activa bearing registration No.KA05JL5010 to the vehicle of accused.
In the result vehicle of accused was damaged.
To which accused demanded Rs.2,000/ for mechanical work.
At that time Pranay Mishra not ready to pay said amount and also abused in Hindi language and deceased moved his vehicle from that place.
To which accused No.1 and 2 followed the vehicle of deceased and punched the vehicle.

Further accused No.1 and 2 by chasing the vehicle of belongs to deceased came near hyper market, next to the KMS Homes apartment, cashier layout, BTM 1st stage, Bengaluru wherein vehicle of accused No.1 and 2 again punched to the vehicle of deceased.
To which deceased fell down.
At that time accused No.1 and 2 stopped their vehicle and accused No.1 and 2 stabbed the deceased Pranay Mishra on his stomach and other parts of the body and caused bleeding injury.
In the result deceased died in the spot.
After knowing the said facts sister of deceased by name Smt.Prachi Mishra lodged the complaint before Madivala police station.
On the basis of the said complaint crime came to be registered in Cr.No.435/2017.
The Investigation Officer has started the investigation.
3. The investigating officer has submitted charge sheet before the III Addl. Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Bengaluru who has committed the case to the court of sessions.
